name: Daemons of War
genericName: War Daemons||Daemon Champions of Conquest||Daemons of Wa'rghul
background:
The Rift Daemons are monstrous servants of the Havoc Gods, who emerge from beneath the surface of Tyria. Their forms vary greatly, depending on which god they serve, and they are accompanied by a variety of daemonic beasts. 

Daemons serve the strange and alien wills of their gods, emerging from the Great Rift and sewing Havoc throughout Tyria. The Daemons are cast offs of dying gods who desperately hope to buy more time for themselves, ready to leave nothing but havoc in their wake, just in hopes of extending their own lives for a little longer.
backgroundFull:
Rift Daemons are born from the last survivors of a pantheon of dying gods, known to Tyria as the Havoc Gods. Desperate to survive, these gods sought out followers from the lost and desperate, and offered them power in exchange for worship. Those who rejected these gods came to know them as Havoc Gods due to the zealotry of their followers and the unrest that they caused. 

The Havoc Gods came to Tyria soon after Voidgates had been discovered. As mages and adventurers activated Voidgates throughout the land, the influence of Havoc began to spread. The Havoc Gods saw Tyria as a fascinating plane due to the diversity of its peoples, where they could find all sorts of different new followers. 

Daemons were sent into Tyria by their gods, spreading throughout the plane. They sought out followers for their Gods, either through promises of power, or shows of force. They found followers throughout Tyria, whom they guided to conquer others. Treachery, war, and bloodshed became commonplace as the Havoc Wars began. Daemons were seen throughout the continent, fighting alone or alongside mortal allies, as they and their masters threatened to overrun the plane.

The Havoc Gods were on the verge of victory when they fell into a desperate trap set by their enemies. The most powerful mages of Tyria gave their lives in a ritual that managed to seal the Havoc Gods into the Orb of Fate. Suddenly severed from their creators, the forces of Havoc were defeated. The surviving Daemons fled and hid throughout Tyria, escaping wherever they could, while their foes enjoyed an era of peace and prosperity. 

This peace was brought to an abrupt end when, centuries later, the orb was broken by the heirs of the most powerful Human Empire in Tyria. The Havoc Gods were freed, and the power unleashed by the broken orb tore through the heart of Tyria, scarring the land and opening a massive fissure, cutting through much of the plane. This great scar became known as the Rift, and from it, the Daemons began to emerge once more into Tyria. 

The Rift Daemons are eager to return to their masters and avenge their defeat. They have already spread throughout many corners of Tyria, and their hordes grow steadily with each passing day. With their old foes complacent and divided, there are few who can stand against them while they are ready to once more bend Tyria to the will of their gods. 

How will you bring glory to your god?

product.description:
For over a century, Cleaverfang has roamed the steppes with his pack of Blood Hounds, slaying Orcs and raiding cattle. It is a simple life of honoring the God of War through battle and blood, away from the despicable machinations of civilizations.

When Champion of War Ironpride comes calling, Cleaverfang wants to turn him away; he has no interest in being a pawn in one of Ironpride’s convoluted schemes. He does not care about Voidgates, diversions and whatever the Last Tear might be.

But the Champion speaks of Brec, the legendary Ratmen city, and Cleaverfang can feel old wounds start aching.

Among the Daemons who serve the God of War, Ironpride has a bad reputation. Not for his weakness, as this Champion of War is a ferocious fighter, but for his deviousness. While most of his brethren value honour above all and strive to defeat their enemies in loyal combat, Ironpride has no such scruples. What he has is burning ambition.

For years, he has led his warband across Tyria to conduct preparations. Ignoring the doubts of his henchmen, he pushes on relentlessly. His plan is almost complete; soon, he swears, the very walls of Brec, the impregnable Ratmen city, will crumble before him.

A War Daemon Fury Champion lands before you, covered in amulets with stolen scrolls and a wizard’s hat hanging off his belt. In one of his hands, he carries a staff with a blade crudely attached to its top. He bares his teeth at you, almost like a smile. He raises a manacled hand, pointing at you as shadows seem to emerge from his wrist.

“I will not allow your kind to lock me, Chainrend, away once more.” His eyes fixate on you. “You were brave to return here, and in honour of that, I shall not imprison you. Instead, I shall grant you the honourable warrior’s death that your ilk denied me."

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Warbound
specialRules.description: When this model attacks enemies that already finished an activation this round, unmodified results of 1 to block hits from weapons deal 1 extra wound.

specialRules.name: Sergeant
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) when attacking.

specialRules.name: Unique Hero
specialRules.description: Counts as having Hero, and this model may only be taken once per army.

specialRules.name: Armor
specialRules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

specialRules.name: Ambush Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Ambush. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Melee Evasion
specialRules.description: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls in melee when attacking units where most models have this rule.

specialRules.name: Piercing Shooter Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get AP(+1) when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Ravage
specialRules.description: Once per round, when it’s this model’s turn to strike in melee, roll X dice before attacking, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

specialRules.name: Bounding Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Bounding. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Furious Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Furious. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unpredictable Fighter. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Reckless Piercing Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Reckless Piercing. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Bounding
specialRules.description: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

specialRules.name: Purge
specialRules.description: When attacking units that are Shaken or Fatigued, this weapon gets AP(+2).

specialRules.name: Reckless Piercing
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is activated, you may roll one die. On a 2+ their weapons get AP(+1) when attacking until the end of the round, but on a 1 enemy units get AP(+1) on their weapons when attacking them instead.

specialRules.name: Spell Resistance
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored. If the wounds were from a spell, then they are ignored on a 2+ instead.

specialRules.name: Defensive Frenzy
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, place one token on this unit when it fully destroys an enemy unit, up to a max. of two tokens. For each token this unit gets +1 to Defense rolls until the end of the game.

specialRules.name: Ignores Regeneration
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Warbound Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Warbound. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Shielded Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Shielded. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
specialRules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Piercing Fighter Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get AP(+1) in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Warbound
specialRules.description: If this model has Warbound, enemies always take wounds on unmodified results of 1 to block from Warbound (instead of only when attacking enemies that already finished an activation).

specialRules.name: Rapid Charge Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game moves +4" when using Charge actions. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Violent
specialRules.description: When this model attacks enemies that already finished an activation this round, unmodified results of 1 to block hits from weapons deal 1 extra wound.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Violent
specialRules.description: If this model has Violent, enemies always take wounds on unmodified results of 1 to block from Violent (instead of only when attacking enemies that already finished an activation).

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Hero
specialRules.description: Units within 6” of friendly Heroes may use the Hero’s Quality for Morale Tests as long as the Hero isn’t Shaken.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Furious
specialRules.description: When charging, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Unpredictable
specialRules.description: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Shielded
specialRules.description: Units where most models have this rule get +1 to Defense rolls against hits that are not from spells.

specialRules.name: Blast
specialRules.description: Ignores Cover, and after resolving other special rules, each hit is multiplied by X. Hits must be split evenly between the target and all enemy units within 3” of any model from the target (defender picks how), but each unit may only take up to as many hits as models in it
